liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The reviewer identified this song as the highlight of the performance [12]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): The reviewer stated that Jerry's emotional delivery in this song gave them chills [15]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): The reviewer described Bobby's performance in this song as his best [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd87-08-15 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-15 t02 Feel Like A Stranger**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-15 t03 Franklin's Tower**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-15 t04 New Minglewood Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-15 t05 Candyman**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-15 t06 Me & My Uncle**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-15 t07 Big River**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-15 t08 Tennessee Jed**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-08-15.142153.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 162 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1987-08-15.prefm.leeds.tetzeli.fix-17010.74165.flac16**: pre-FM broadcast master; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd87-08-15.prefm.leeds.17010.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 21 songs; 160 min; rated 4.13/5 by 15 [4]. Said about its sound: The reviewer suspected the fiddle sound was actually Brent Mydland on keyboards; The foggy but full-bodied sound gives the song a smoky nighttime appeal; The reviewer described the FM analog source as great sounding [18][20][21]
- **gd1987-08-15.163856.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 156 min [6]

## Around the show

- The free concert took place in a beautiful location on a beautiful day [12]
- Mickey Hart led a percussion procession through Telluride streets after the first night [14]
- Unidentified fiddle and pedal steel players accompanied the band on this song [16]
- Unidentified fiddle and pedal steel players accompanied the band on this song [17]
- The reviewer asked why the shows were free at this non-corporate venue [20]
- The reviewer danced with Mickey Hart during a moving drumming jam down Main Street [22]
- The shows occurred during the harmonic convergence in a beautiful remote place [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-08-15.142153.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC3/MK41 mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif >… [1]
- **gd1987-08-15.prefm.leeds.tetzeli.fix-17010.74165.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Patch fix of shnid 17010 [3]. Also: Beginning of Scarlet Begonias patched from Ladner FOB, pitch and volume matched [3]
- **gd87-08-15.prefm.leeds.17010.sbeok.shnf**: source: PreFM SBD(Healy Mix)>MC>DAT>CDR>EAC>WAVE LAB>CD WAVE>MKW>SHN (Seekable) [4]
- **gd1987-08-15.163856.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME80 mics > Sony D5M [6]. Also: Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplies a patch in the Drums to Space transition [6]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Town Park - August 16, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/august-16-1987) [25]
